name: Suspicious Binary Execution from Temporary Directory
description: Detects executable launch originating from user AppData\Local\Temp or Unix /tmp directories.
explanation: Droppers and exploit kits frequently stage their secondary executable payloads inside world-writable temporary directories.
investigation_steps: Compute SHA-256 hash of the binary in the temporary folder.
Identify the dropping process by inspecting parent PID and recent FIM creation events.
Examine command-line parameters and subsequent network sockets.
